**Discpress 1.3.6 fixes a blurry header on iPhone and iPad** when Discpress is opened from the Home Screen or inside apps like Sitecase.

## Get it

- **[⬇ discpress.html](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress/releases/download/v1.3.6/discpress.html)** (about 2.9 MB): the whole app in one file you keep.
- **[🌐 powerbeef.github.io/discpress](https://powerbeef.github.io/discpress/)**: nothing to download, and the way to convert big games on iPhone and iPad. If you added it to your Home Screen, open it once while online to get this version.

## Fix

- **The header is sharp again from the Home Screen.** There, the header stays put while the page scrolls below it, but it kept a frosted-glass effect meant for Safari, where the page scrolls under the header. iOS drew it, text included, out of focus. It now has a plain background there; Safari keeps the effect.

The CHDs are the same as 1.3.0's.
